method: Single-pass visual reading of the two original Marathi scanned pages, including Devanagari digits. English labels are translations; an independent language and effective-date check remains.
date_status: Printed Thursday 8 May 2025; operational implementation date and later revisions require verification.

fare_rules.over_50_km_concessional_application: The extra-stage cell spans adult and concessional columns; separate concession treatment is not explicit.
fare_rules.outside_bmc_toll_point_scope: The note applies an addition to Non-AC and AC journeys through toll points outside municipal limits; the count of chargeable crossings and mapping require verification.
fare_rules.luggage_basis: Corresponding adult fare, subject to the stated ceiling.
fare_rules.distance_basis: Distance between fare stages, not distance between the two bus stops.
fare_rules.distance_notification_reference: Maharashtra Home Department notification dated 8 July 2011, cited on page 1; original notification and stage-point list not yet acquired.

pass_rules.ac_and_non_ac_product_eligibility: The pass table does not separate AC and Non-AC columns; do not infer universal eligibility or GST handling.

limitations: This document is linked by the official transport page but does not prove no later amendment exists.
A separate current concession-eligibility rule is needed; the fare column label alone does not identify all eligible passengers.
The undated facilities webpage and this dated PDF differ on AC concession availability; both sources must be retained.
Actual fare-stage locations, rounding, tax collection, transfer charging and electronic product eligibility remain unresolved.
These ordinary fare tables do not establish premium Chalo fares or pass validity on premium services.
No passenger uptake, trip frequency or pass ownership is inferred from a fare product.
